Custom ggplot2 theme with warm, paper-like aesthetics

Source: R/ggplot2-themes.R
theme_avom.Rd

A minimal ggplot2 theme based on theme_minimal() with customized fonts, colors, and legend positioning. Designed for a warm, paper-like aesthetic with configurable typography and color scheme.

Usage

theme_avom(
  base_size = 12,
  base_family = "Fira Sans",
  header_family = "Arvo",
  ink = "#665c54",
  paper = "cornsilk",
  accent = "#d65d0e"
)

Arguments

base_size

Base font size in points. Default is 12.

base_family

Base font family for plot text. Default is "Fira Sans".

header_family

Font family for headers and titles. Default is "Arvo".

ink

Color for text and lines (analogous to ink on paper). Default is "#665c54".

paper

Background color (analogous to paper). Default is "cornsilk".

accent

Accent color for highlights and emphasis. Default is "#d65d0e".

Value

A ggplot2 theme object that can be added to a ggplot.

Details

The theme removes minor grid lines and positions the legend at the bottom with text above the legend keys. The function checks for font availability using systemfonts::require_font() before applying them.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_avom()

# With custom colors
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_avom(ink = "#333333", paper = "white", accent = "#0066cc")
} # }
